persona.title: What are you here to make a video for?
persona.body: Pick the closest one. We use it for the examples and tips you see. You can make anything later.

creator.title: My channel or my followers
creator.words: I film all week and edit all weekend.

business.title: My business
business.words: I know we need video. I run a business, I am not an editor.

educator.title: My lessons or my course
educator.words: My best lessons are stuck in hour-long recordings.

nonprofit.title: My cause or my community
nonprofit.words: We have the stories and the clips. Nobody on the team edits.

software.title: My app or software product
software.words: We ship every week and announce it with a screenshot.

other.title: Something else
other.words: I have a story to tell and no time to tell it.

material.title: What do you have to start from?
material.body: This decides what we set up for you first. One click and your first project is ready for it.

footage.title: Clips I already shot
footage.body: From a phone, a camera or a screen recording. The dead air and the retakes get cut.

code.title: An app or website I built
code.body: Add its source code and get a promo video of its screens.

idea.title: Just an idea so far
idea.body: Describe it and get an animated video, or film five short clips on your phone and add them here.

error.title: Your project could not be set up

samples.offer: No clips handy? Try it with our sample clips
samples.unverifiedTitle: Confirm your email to use the sample clips
samples.unverifiedBody: Open the link we sent to your inbox, then try again. Your project is ready, and your own clips can go in right now.
samples.failedTitle: The sample clips could not be added
samples.failedBody: Your project is ready. You can add your own clips right now.
samples.someFailedTitle: Some sample clips could not be added
samples.someFailedBody: {added, plural, one {# sample clip is} other {# sample clips are}} in your project. You can add more of your own.

shots.title: Film these five clips on your phone
shots.body: About ten seconds each is plenty. Five different shots give the edit something to work with. One long take can only be trimmed.
shots.tip: Hold the phone still, find good light, and let each clip run a second longer than feels natural.
shots.ready: I have my clips. Add them
shots.laterHint: Your project is saved. This list is on your dashboard when you come back.

creator.one: You, to the camera: one sentence on what this video is about.
creator.two: A slow look around the place where it happens.
creator.three: Your hands doing the main thing, up close.
creator.four: The moment you most want people to see.
creator.five: You again: what you would tell a friend to try next.

business.one: The front of your place, or your product on a table, in daylight.
business.two: You or a colleague at work, hands busy.
business.three: The product or the finished result, up close.
business.four: What a customer sees first: the door, the counter or the box being opened.
business.five: You, to the camera: what you offer and how to get it.

educator.one: You, to the camera: the one thing this lesson teaches.
educator.two: The board, the screen or the page you teach from.
educator.three: Your hands showing the key step.
educator.five: You again: what to practice next.

nonprofit.one: The place where your work happens.
nonprofit.two: People doing the work, filmed with their permission.
nonprofit.three: One detail that shows why it matters: a sign, a tool or a finished job.
nonprofit.four: You or a volunteer, to the camera: what you do, in one sentence.
nonprofit.five: How people can help: the event, the page or the collection box.

software.one: Your product on its screen, doing its main job from start to finish.
software.two: The old way people do this today, shown once.
software.three: One feature up close, used slowly.
software.four: You, to the camera: who it is for, in one sentence.
software.five: The last screen people should remember: the result or the sign-up page.

agency.one: The client's place or product, from a few steps back.
agency.two: The product or the service in use, up close.
agency.three: Someone from the client's team, to the camera: what they offer.
agency.four: One detail of the brand: the sign, the packaging or the logo.
agency.five: The closing shot: where people should go next.

other.one: You, to the camera: what this video is about, in one sentence.
other.two: The place where the story happens.
other.five: The ending: what you want people to do or remember.
